r: stats::reshape(data, direction = "long", varying = list(c("var2000", "var2001")), v.names = "var", timevar = "year", times = c(2000, 2001), idvar = "id")
task: Reshape repeated measurements to long form with base R
task_zh: 使用基础 R 将重复测量转为长格式
detail: Explicitly list the wide columns and time values. This fixed workflow uses var2000 and var2001; adapt those names to your data.
detail_zh: 需要明确列出宽格式列和时间取值。本固定工作流程使用 var2000 和 var2001，请按实际数据修改列名。

r: stats::reshape(data, direction = "wide", v.names = "var", timevar = "year", idvar = "id", sep = "")
task: Reshape repeated measurements to wide form with base R
task_zh: 使用基础 R 将重复测量转为宽格式
detail: Requires one row per id/year combination. R row ordering and attributes differ from Stata; compare keys and values explicitly.
detail_zh: 每个 id/year 组合需要恰有一行。R 的行顺序和属性可能与 Stata 不同，应按键和取值核对结果。
